tasks.label: Git: verify branch state
tasks.command: git status --short --branch; Write-Host '---'; git log --oneline --decorate --graph -n 8; Write-Host '---'; git branch -vv

tasks.label: Check diff after task update
tasks.command: $repo = 'C:\Users\Admin\Desktop\Fligght price tracker'; Set-Location $repo; git status --short --branch; Write-Host '---'; git diff -- .vscode/tasks.json

tasks.label: Commit task updates to feature branch
tasks.command: $repo = 'C:\Users\Admin\Desktop\Fligght price tracker'; Set-Location $repo; git add .vscode/tasks.json; git commit -m 'Add project VS Code tasks'; git push

tasks.label: Verify CI checks locally
tasks.command: Set-Location 'C:/Users/Admin/Desktop/Fligght price tracker'; python -m pip install -r requirements.txt; python -m black --check src tests; pytest -q

tasks.label: Format code and run tests with project path
tasks.command: Set-Location 'C:/Users/Admin/Desktop/Fligght price tracker'; black src tests; $env:PYTHONPATH='.'; pytest -q

tasks.label: Final CI validation
tasks.command: Set-Location 'C:/Users/Admin/Desktop/Fligght price tracker'; $env:PYTHONPATH='.'; python -m black --check src tests; pytest -q

tasks.label: Commit CI pipeline changes
tasks.command: Set-Location 'C:/Users/Admin/Desktop/Fligght price tracker'; git add .; git commit -m 'Add CI checks and pytest config'; git push
